Trump-Putin's SECRET Ukraine Deal: Why Europe Feels Betrayed and Powerless | GRAVITAS
The anxiety across European capitals stems from recent closed-door maneuvers by U.S. President Donald Trump, who is heavily pushing for what he calls a "big, beautiful agreement" involving all of Europe to end the war in Ukraine. These rapid developments have culminated in highly anticipated, U.S.-mediated trilateral talks between the U.S., Russia, and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi.
